name: settings-two
title: Settings Two
description: A comprehensive account settings dashboard for profile, appearance, notifications, security, and destructive actions.

files.content: Changes apply to your account only.
efferd.com/
{#each themeOptions as option (option.value)} {@const Icon = option.icon} {option.label} {/each}

<script lang="ts">
	import { FieldSeparator } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { Switch } from "#lib/components/ui/switch/index.js";
	import SettingField from "./setting-field.svelte";
	import SettingsSection from "./settings-section.svelte";

	const notifications = [
		{
			id: "product-updates",
			label: "Product updates",
			description: "New features and release notes.",
			defaultChecked: true
		},
		{
			id: "weekly-digest",
			label: "Weekly digest",
			description: "A Monday summary of activity.",
			defaultChecked: true
		},
		{
			id: "mentions",
			label: "Mentions",
			description: "When someone @mentions you.",
			defaultChecked: true
		},
		{
			id: "billing-alerts",
			label: "Billing alerts",
			description: "Failed payments and renewals.",
			defaultChecked: false
		}
	] as const;
</script>

<SettingsSection description="Choose what we email you." title="Notifications">
	{#each notifications as item, index (item.id)}
		{#if index > 0}<FieldSeparator />{/if}
		<SettingField
			description={item.description}
			htmlFor={item.id}
			label={item.label}
			orientation="horizontal"
		>
			<Switch checked={item.defaultChecked} id={item.id} />
		</SettingField>
	{/each}
</SettingsSection>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { FieldSeparator } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { Switch } from "#lib/components/ui/switch/index.js";
	import SettingField from "./setting-field.svelte";
	import SettingsSection from "./settings-section.svelte";
</script>

<SettingsSection description="Keep your account safe." title="Security">
	<SettingField
		description="Require a code when signing in."
		htmlFor="two-factor"
		label="Two-factor auth"
		orientation="horizontal"
	>
		<Switch checked id="two-factor" />
	</SettingField>
	<FieldSeparator />
	<SettingField
		description="Last changed 3 months ago."
		htmlFor="change-password"
		label="Password"
		orientation="horizontal"
	>
		<Button id="change-password" size="sm" type="button" variant="outline">Change</Button>
	</SettingField>
	<FieldSeparator />
	<SettingField
		description="Signed in on 3 devices."
		htmlFor="sign-out-sessions"
		label="Sessions"
		orientation="horizontal"
	>
		<Button id="sign-out-sessions" size="sm" type="button" variant="outline"
			>Sign out all</Button
		>
	</SettingField>
</SettingsSection>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { FieldSeparator } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import SettingField from "./setting-field.svelte";
	import SettingsSection from "./settings-section.svelte";
</script>

<SettingsSection description="Irreversible and destructive actions." title="Danger zone">
	<SettingField
		description="Download a copy of your data."
		htmlFor="export-data"
		label="Export data"
		orientation="horizontal"
	>
		<Button id="export-data" size="sm" type="button" variant="outline">Export</Button>
	</SettingField>
	<FieldSeparator />
	<SettingField
		description="Remove your account and all its data."
		htmlFor="delete-account"
		label="Delete account"
		orientation="horizontal"
	>
		<Button id="delete-account" size="sm" type="button" variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
	</SettingField>
</SettingsSection>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Card,
		CardContent,
		CardDescription,
		CardHeader,
		CardTitle
	} from "#lib/components/ui/card/index.js";
	import { FieldGroup } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { cn } from "#lib/utils.js";
	import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";

	type Props = ComponentProps<typeof Card> & {
		title: string;
		description: string;
		children: Snippet;
	};

	let { title, description, children, class: className, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Card class={cn("rounded-none bg-background py-0 shadow-none ring-0", className)} {...restProps}>
	<CardHeader class="gap-0 border-b py-4">
		<CardTitle>{title}</CardTitle>
		<CardDescription>{description}</CardDescription>
	</CardHeader>
	<CardContent class="flex-1 py-5">
		<FieldGroup class="gap-5">
			{@render children()}
		</FieldGroup>
	</CardContent>
</Card>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Field,
		FieldContent,
		FieldDescription,
		FieldLabel
	} from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { cn } from "#lib/utils.js";
	import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";

	type Props = ComponentProps<typeof Field> & {
		label: string;
		description: string;
		htmlFor: string;
		children: Snippet;
	};

	let { label, description, htmlFor, children, class: className, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Field
	class={cn("@md/field-group:has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:items-center", className)}
	orientation="responsive"
	{...restProps}
>
	<FieldContent>
		<FieldLabel class="font-normal" for={htmlFor}>{label}</FieldLabel>
		<FieldDescription class="text-xs">{description}</FieldDescription>
	</FieldContent>
	{@render children()}
</Field>
